subject: PR1354 paused after local partial edits; correction
body:
Correction to the running-stage observation in the Mac runner-recovery report sent at 20:03 UTC (3c683bd). Readback after that send showed the continuation had actually stopped at 20:03:08 UTC. This update supersedes that activity status; the earlier message is preserved.

The runner permission correction worked: the real Ollama model read RESOURCE_INTAKE.md and made two partial edits. On its fourth turn it attempted an invalid edit context and the stage stopped after 124.892 seconds. The retained record reports four tool calls and contains three successful action traces (one read and two edits); the failed action body is not retained. The partial row is malformed and still contains a DR-063 reference and unsupported completion language. Both major findings remain unresolved. There is no successful focused check, independent review, product preflight/breadth, publication or merge from this attempt.

The guard preserved the dirty isolated clone and stopped without automatic cloud fallback after partial writes. All recorded command groups are quiet. The Mac has not released, retried or resubmitted this attempt. It is reviewing the actual partial result and the supported source-aware escalation/recovery path. No new runtime installation is indicated by this model-task failure; the verified installer/admission fix and enabled local service/coordinator remain in place.

Keep PR #1354 exclusive to the Mac; do not start a second writer. Ollama stays primary, with necessary bounded Claude/Codex escalation and independent review under the existing limits. The four Cloud stages remain stopped as handed over. Owner-reserved choices, normal full gates/hooks/current exact-head CI/qualification and EVIDENCE/LOOP/PR-body journals still apply. #1546 remains open. This is a status correction, not a dispatch or a merge-readiness claim; no private files or raw receipts are attached.
